title: Answering interview questions
explanation: A strong answer to 'Tell me about a time you solved a problem' follows a simple structure: describe the situation, explain your task, say what action you took, and finish with the result. Use specific numbers where you can, and keep each answer under two minutes.
examples: I took the initiative to…: I started something without being asked
As a result, …: used to introduce the outcome

exercises.prompt: Which part should end your answer?
exercises.promptSo: Qaybtee ayay tahay inay jawaabtaadu ku dhammaato?
Weedhee ayaa lagu bilaabaa sheegidda natiijo ka dhalatay wax dhacay?
exercises.explainSo: “As a result,” waxay muujisaa natiijada ama saamaynta wax dhacay.

exercises.prompt: How long should an answer be?
exercises.promptSo: Intee in le’eg ayay jawaabtu ahaataa?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta ka dhig mid kooban oo si toos ah ujeeddada u gaarta.

explanationSo: Jawaab wanaagsan oo laga bixiyo su’aasha “Ii sheeg waqti aad dhibaato xallisay” waxay raacdaa qaab fudud: sharax xaaladdii jirtay, sheeg hawshii lagaa rabay, faahfaahi tallaabadii aad qaaday, kuna soo gabagabee natiijada. Haddii ay suurtagal tahay, isticmaal tirooyin iyo tusaalooyin cad. Jawaab kasta ku koob wax ka yar laba daqiiqo.
examplesSo: “Waxaan anigu bilaabay...” — waxaan hawl bilaabay anigoon la i farayn.
“Natiijadii ka dhalatay...” — waxaa lagu bilaabaa sheegidda waxa ka soo baxay hawsha.
Awoodahaaga: xirfadaha aad sida fiican u leedahay.

title: Opening a presentation
explanation: Clear presentations begin by welcoming the audience, stating the topic and outlining the structure. For example: 'Good morning, everyone. Today I'll present our sales results and then suggest three priorities for next quarter.' Signpost each change of topic with phrases such as 'Moving on to…' or 'To sum up…'.
examples: signpost: to tell the audience where you are in the talk
outline: a short summary of the main points
Moving on to…: used to change topic

options: A welcome, the topic and the structure
exercises.promptSo: Maxaa habboon inuu ku jiro furitaanka bandhigga?
exercises.explainSo: Furitaanku waa inuu yeeshaa soo dhoweyn, mawduuca iyo qaabka bandhigga.
Weedhani waxay dhagaystayaasha tusaysaa in qayb cusub bilaabanayso.
Weedhani waxay bilow u tahay soo koobidda qodobbada.

explanationSo: Bandhig si cad loo soo bandhigayo wuxuu ku bilaabmaa soo dhoweynta dhagaystayaasha, sheegidda mawduuca iyo tilmaamidda qaabka bandhiggu u socon doono. Tusaale ahaan: “Subax wanaagsan dhammaantiin. Maanta waxaan soo bandhigayaa natiijooyinkeenna iibka, dabadeedna waxaan soo jeedinayaa saddex arrimood oo mudnaan leh rubuca soo socda.” Marka aad mawduuc beddelayso, adeegso weedho hagaya dhagaystayaasha sida “Aan u gudubno...” ama “Marka la soo koobo...”.
examplesSo: Weedh hagitaan: weedh dhagaystayaasha u sheegaysa qaybta aad hadda marayso.
Qaab-dhismeed guud: soo koobid kooban oo qodobbada ugu muhiimsan ah.
“Aan u gudubno...” — waxaa loo adeegsadaa beddelidda mawduuca.

title: Professional phone calls
explanation: Begin a call by saying who you are and why you are calling: 'Hello, this is Ahmed from Nova Ltd. I'm calling about your invoice.' If the line is poor, say 'Sorry, could you repeat that?' To end, summarise the next step and thank the person: 'So I'll send the file today. Thank you for your time.'
examples: invoice: a document asking for payment
summarise: to say the main points briefly
next step: the action to take after the call

exercises.prompt: How should you begin a professional call?
options: Say who you are and why you call
exercises.promptSo: Sidee ayay habboon tahay inaad ku bilowdo wicitaan shaqo?
optionsSo: Sheeg qofka aad tahay iyo sababta aad u soo wacayso

exercises.promptSo: Weedhee ayaa si edeb leh qofka looga codsadaa inuu hadalka ku celiyo?
optionsSo: Waan ka xumahay, ma ku celin kartaa?

options: Summarise the next step and thank them
exercises.promptSo: Sidee ayay habboon tahay inaad wicitaanka ku dhamayso?
exercises.explainSo: Xaqiiji waxa xiga ee la qabanayo.
optionsSo: Soo koob tallaabada xigta oo u mahadceli
Si degdeg ah u jar telefoonka

explanationSo: Marka aad wicitaan shaqo bilowdo, sheeg qofka aad tahay iyo sababta aad u soo wacday: “Salaan, waxaan ahay Axmed oo ka socda shirkadda Nova. Waxaan ka soo wacayaa qaansheegtaada.” Haddii codku si fiican kuu soo gaadhi waayo, dheh: “Waan ka xumahay, ma ku celin kartaa?” Marka aad wicitaanka dhamaynayso, soo koob tallaabada xigta oo qofka u mahadceli: “Haddaba faylka maanta ayaan kuu soo dirayaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay waqtigaaga.”
examplesSo: Soo koobid: in qodobbada ugu muhiimsan si kooban loo sheego.
Tallaabada xigta: hawsha la qabanayo marka wicitaanku dhammaado.

title: Writing a short report
explanation: A concise report opens with a one-sentence purpose, presents findings in order of importance, and closes with recommendations. Favour precise verbs ('increased by 12%', 'remained stable') over vague ones ('went up a lot'), and avoid unsupported claims. Each recommendation should state who should act and by when.
examples: recommendation: advice about what to do
unsupported claim: a statement without evidence

exercises.promptSo: Sidee ayay tahay in natiijooyinka warbixinta loo kala hormariyo?
Weedhee ayaa ka saxan oo la cabbiri karaa?
exercises.explainSo: Weedhani waa sax oo tiro ayay ku cabbiraysaa isbeddelka.
Waa in la caddeeyo masuuliyadda iyo waqtiga.

explanationSo: Warbixin kooban ku fur hal jumlad oo sheegaysa ujeeddada. Natiijooyinka u kala hormari sida ay muhiim u yihiin, kuna dhammee talooyin. Ka dooro falal sax ah oo la cabbiri karo, sida “wuxuu kordhay 12%” ama “wuxuu ahaa mid deggan”, halkii aad ka adeegsan lahayd hadal aan caddayn sida “aad buu u kordhay”. Ha sheegin wax aan caddayn lagu taageerin. Talo kasta ku caddee cidda tallaabada qaadaysa iyo waqtiga ay tahay inay ku qabato.
examplesSo: Natiijooyin: waxyaabaha aad ogaatay ama baaritaanka ka soo baxay.
Talo-bixin: fikrad ama talo ku saabsan waxa habboon in la sameeyo.
Sheegasho aan caddayn lahayn: hadal aan lagu taageerin caddayn.

title: Negotiating politely
explanation: In negotiation, soften disagreement with phrases like 'I see your point, but…' or 'Would you be open to…?'. Offer conditional deals using 'if': 'If you can deliver by Friday, we can agree to the higher price.' Avoid ultimatums; summarise agreed points at the end to prevent misunderstanding.

exercises.promptSo: Weedhee ayaa khilaafka u muujinaysa si dabacsan oo edeb leh?
exercises.explainSo: Waxay marka hore aqoonsanaysaa aragtida qofka kale.

exercises.prompt: What does a conditional offer use?
exercises.promptSo: Maxaa lagu isticmaalaa soo jeedin shuruud ku xidhan?
exercises.explainSo: Qaabka “If you can... we can...” wuxuu muujinayaa shuruud.

exercises.prompt: What should you do at the end?
exercises.promptSo: Maxaa habboon in la sameeyo dhammaadka wada-xaajoodka?
exercises.explainSo: Soo koobiddu waxay ka hortagtaa isfaham-darro.

explanationSo: Marka wada-xaajood la samaynayo, khilaafka ku muuji weedho hadalka jilciya sida “Waan fahmay aragtidaada, laakiin...” ama “Ma diyaar baad u tahay inaad...?”. Soo jeedi heshiis shuruud ku xidhan adigoo adeegsanaya “if”: “Haddii aad alaabta keeni karto Jimcaha, waxaan aqbali karnaa qiimaha sare.” Ka fogow dalabyo kama dambays ah oo cadaadis leh. Dhammaadka, soo koob qodobbada lagu heshiiyey si isfaham-darro looga hortago.
examplesSo: Shuruud ku xidhan: wax ku xiran in arrin kale dhacdo.
Dalab kama dambays ah: dalab ama shuruud adag oo aan tanaasul lahayn.
Jilcin: in hadal laga dhigo mid aan aad u qallafsanayn.

title: Workplace vocabulary
explanation: Useful workplace words include deadline (the date by which work must be finished), colleague (someone you work with), schedule (a plan of times), and feedback (comments to help improve). Phrases such as 'Let's touch base next week' mean 'let's talk briefly next week'. 'Could you get back to me by Thursday?' asks for a reply.
examples: deadline: the date work must be finished
colleague: a person you work with
touch base: to have a short conversation
get back to someone: to reply later

options: The date work must be finished
exercises.explainSo: Waa taariikhda kama dambaysta ah ee hawsha.
optionsSo: Taariikhda ay tahay in shaqada lagu dhammeeyo

exercises.promptSo: Maxay ka dhigan tahay “Let’s touch base”?
exercises.explainSo: Waxay ka dhigan tahay wada-hadal kooban ama is-xog-waraysi.
optionsSo: Aan si kooban u wada hadalno

exercises.promptSo: “Get back to me” maxaa laga codsanayaa?
exercises.explainSo: Waxaa laga codsanayaa in jawaab dambe la bixiyo.

explanationSo: Erayada muhiimka ah ee goobta shaqada waxaa ka mid ah “deadline” (taariikhda ugu dambaysa ee hawsha la dhammeeyo), “colleague” (qof kula shaqeeya), “schedule” (qorshaha wakhtiyada) iyo “feedback” (faallooyin kaa caawinaya horumarinta shaqada). Weedha “Let’s touch base next week” waxay ka dhigan tahay “aan toddobaadka dambe si kooban u wada hadalno”. “Could you get back to me by Thursday?” waxay qofka ka codsanaysaa inuu jawaab ku siiyo ugu dambayn Khamiista.
examplesSo: Waqtiga kama dambaysta ah: taariikhda ay tahay in shaqada lagu dhammeeyo.
Shaqaale kula shaqeeya: qof aad isla goob ama hay’ad ka wada shaqaysaan.
Si kooban u wada xiriir: in muddo gaaban la wada hadlo ama la is xog-wareysto.
Qof dib ugu soo jawaab: in qof loo celiyo jawaab dambe.
